# OfficeAIM

> OfficeAIM is a 100% free, open-source educational laboratory and interactive campus dedicated to autonomous AI agent workflows, prompt engineering, and modern web architectures.

## Core Pages & Directories
- [Landing Page](https://officeaim.com/): Overview of the open educational platform, architecture, and free tooling.
- [Learn Directory](https://officeaim.com/learn.html): Minimalist learning pathways covering workflows, blueprints, and interactive modules.
- [AI Skills Library](https://officeaim.com/skills.html): 15 production-ready AI agent prompts formatted with guided natural language instructions and cross-LLM launcher.
- [Prompt Generator](https://officeaim.com/prompt-generator.html): Interactive meta-prompt builder designed to structure complex role prompts and frameworks.
- [Newsroom & Intelligence](https://officeaim.com/news.html): Latest telemetry, release updates, and technical breakthroughs.
- [Community & Mentorship](https://officeaim.com/community.html): Free community learning, YouTube courses, and mentorship channels.

## Technical Architecture & Blueprints
- [Architectural Blueprint](https://officeaim.com/blueprint.html): Deep dive into multi-agent systems, client-side sovereignty, and edge deployments.
- [Automated Workflows](https://officeaim.com/use-cases.html): Step-by-step guides for connecting n8n, Supabase, and Google Gemini into production pipelines.
- [Security & Trust](https://officeaim.com/security.html): Zero-trust security model, client-side data privacy, and compliance guidelines.
- [Realtime Board](https://officeaim.com/board.html): Live operational telemetry and status board.

## Free Open-Source Tooling
- [Free Stack Kit](https://officeaim.com/resources/free-stack-kit.html): Curated zero-cost tech stack guide for solo developers and builders.
- [Website Creator Guide](https://officeaim.com/resources/website-creator.html): Framework-free Jamstack development methodology.
- [QR Generator](https://officeaim.com/resources/qr-generator.html): Zero-telemetry client-side SVG QR code generator.
- [Library Tracker](https://officeaim.com/resources/library-tracker.html): Autonomous asset and dependency tracking utility.
